user.title: Connect to Pantry Raider
user.description: Point this at your Pantry Raider install. Leave the API key blank to pair: you approve a code on the kitchen screen instead of copying a key by hand.

data.api_key: API key (optional; leave blank to pair)

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add this Pantry Raider install?
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found {name} on your network. Add it now and approve the pairing code on the kitchen screen.

pair.title: Approve on your kitchen
pair.description: Pantry Raider is showing pairing code {code}. Approve the request on the kitchen screen (or in Pantry Raider under Settings, Bandit Remotes), then press Submit here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Pantry Raider
reauth_confirm.description: Approve the code on the kitchen screen or in Pantry Raider under Settings, Bandit Remotes, or paste a key made in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Pantry Raider at that address. Check the host and port, and that you used the LAN address.
error.invalid_auth: Pantry Raider rejected the API key. Copy it from Settings, Security.
error.pairing_pending: Not approved yet. Approve it on the kitchen, then try again.
error.pairing_unavailable: Pairing is unavailable on this install (it may be turned off in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security). Paste an API key instead.
error.pairing_key_missing: The kitchen approved Home Assistant, but its key did not arrive. Press Submit to try again.

abort.already_configured: This Pantry Raider install is already set up.
abort.pairing_denied: The pairing request was denied on the kitchen.
abort.pairing_expired: The pairing request expired. Start again and approve it within a few minutes.

init.title: Pantry Raider options
init.description: How often Home Assistant checks Pantry Raider for updates, and whether Pantry Raider is given a link back to Home Assistant for cameras, Stream Deck keys and thermometers. Turning the link off removes only the tokens this integration created.

data.connect_back: Let Pantry Raider connect back to Home Assistant

camera_popup.name: Camera pop-up
camera_popup.description: Pop a camera feed up on a Pantry Raider screen, for example when someone rings the doorbell.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Which Pantry Raider screen shows the pop-up. Leave empty to use your main install when only one is set up.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera's name as set on Pantry Raider's Cameras page. Leave empty for the first configured camera.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the pop-up stays on screen. Leave at 0 to use the length set in Pantry Raider.

camera_detect.name: Camera detection
camera_detect.description: Report a camera detection and let Pantry Raider decide whether to pop the camera up, using each camera's own "pop up on" checkboxes. One automation can send every detection type it sees.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Which Pantry Raider screen shows the pop-up. Leave empty to use your main install when only one is set up.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera's name as set on Pantry Raider's Cameras page. Leave empty for the first configured camera.

detection_type.name: Detection type
detection_type.description: What the camera saw. Visitor means a doorbell button press.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the pop-up stays on screen. Leave at 0 to use the length set in Pantry Raider.

probe_alert.name: Probe alert
probe_alert.description: Pantry Raider calls this when a thermometer probe reaches its target. It fires the pantry_raider_probe_alert event with the alert's details, so automations can react.

pair_needed.title: Pair Home Assistant with Pantry Raider

confirm.title: Pair Home Assistant with Pantry Raider
confirm.description: This Pantry Raider install accepts Home Assistant without a key today, but that stops once a password is set. Pair now so it keeps working.

pairing_off.title: Pairing is turned off in Pantry Raider

confirm.title: Pairing is turned off in Pantry Raider
confirm.description: Turn on device pairing in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security (Allow devices on your home network to request access), then press Submit.

app_update_needed.title: Update Pantry Raider
app_update_needed.description: Update Pantry Raider so Home Assistant can give it a limited account instead of the owner account.

open_install_grace.title: Pantry Raider needs a password
open_install_grace.description: Pantry Raider at {host} has no password, so from {date} it stops answering requests that come through a proxy or tunnel. To keep that access, turn on two-factor sign-in in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security, then set a password there. Signing in from outside your home network needs both.

open_install_name.title: Pantry Raider does not know one of its names
open_install_name.description: Pantry Raider at {host} was opened by a name it does not know, so from {date} it stops answering that name. If you use that name, add it under Other names for this kitchen in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security.

manual_token.title: Pantry Raider uses a token you pasted
manual_token.description: Pantry Raider is using a Home Assistant token that was pasted into its settings, so this integration leaves it as it is. To let the integration give Pantry Raider a limited account of its own, clear that token in Pantry Raider under Settings, Home Assistant, then reload this integration.
